scope.description: Edit scope. A CLOSED set on purpose: an unknown value must fail validation, never fall into a silent default. Editing a single occurrence is `appointments.appointments.reschedule`, and 'all events' does not exist here because it would rewrite a past that is already charged and filed.

from_occurrence_date.description: The occurrence the change starts at. Pulled forward to today if it points at the past: the past is frozen.
